items.title: Dunkin Donuts signage at 1962 Beacon Street
items.summary: Design review of new store signage for a Dunkin Donuts at 1962 Beacon Street in Brighton.

items.title: Loring-Greenough House garden and path renovation
items.summary: The Landmarks Commission will review plans to replant the perennial borders and replace the lawn path with bluestone pavers at the historic Loring-Greenough House in Jamaica Plain. You can testify at the virtual hearing or email written comments.

items.title: Blue Cross Blue Shield Building residential conversion
items.summary: The Landmarks Commission will review plans to rehabilitate the Brutalist Blue Cross Blue Shield Building at 133 Federal Street, with housing on the upper floors and retail on the ground floor. You can testify at the virtual hearing or email written comments.
